nodes.name: Email Trigger (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Polls Gmail INBOX every minute for UNSEEN messages whose subject contains 'Rental Watcher'. Marks them as read after processing so we don't reprocess. Uses the existing Personal Gmail IMAP credential — no Gmail OAuth2 needed. Reusable pattern for other email-driven workflows: swap the SUBJECT filter and the downstream parser.

nodes.name: Match L# tags + load prefs
nodes.notes: Reusable email-app pattern: parse the IMAP message body for command tokens, resolve them against on-disk state, hand off to a downstream Apply node. To reuse: swap the TAG_PAT regex and the loadSentMappings/lookup logic.
